name: action-stale-cleanup
description: GitHub Action for safe stale PR and branch cleanup

scripts.format: prettier --write action.yml package.json 'src/**/*.{js,cjs}' 'scripts/**/*.cjs' '.github/workflows/*.yml' 'examples/*.yml' README.md OPEN_POINTS.md PR_ALIGNMENT_PLAN.md 'docs/**/*.md'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check action.yml package.json 'src/**/*.{js,cjs}' 'scripts/**/*.cjs' '.github/workflows/*.yml' 'examples/*.yml' README.md OPEN_POINTS.md PR_ALIGNMENT_PLAN.md 'docs/**/*.md'
